checks: unified queue contains correction and merge tasks and read audit precedes return
administrators and ASHAs without assignment cannot read patient tasks
a merge counterpart outside care scope hides its task and counts
stale hashed cursors restart the queue without skipping work
assignment commits once and creates scoped in-app notice
out-of-scope assignee and stale assignment history are rejected
only the current recipient acknowledges a notice
merge assignment requires an eligible steward with access to both records
assigning a task does not close it or modify downstream evidence
historical preview is read-only and identifies missing obligations
stale reviewed backfill plans are refused
reviewed historical apply and new-key retry append one set of tasks without external action
existing task records are never overwritten by historical backfill
assignment notices disappear immediately when the recipient loses current patient scope
a failed read audit refuses the whole queue without returning task details
limits: Built local Worker and D1; synthetic fixtures, no hosted or real clinical acceptance.
